text: You're looking for a sweet treat that fits within your 60-minute time frame and aligns with your goal of reducing sugar intake. The Chocolate Cherry Chewies recipe checks both boxes. Made with unsweetened cocoa and low-fat sweetened condensed milk, these chewies have a rich flavor profile without being overly sweet. The inclusion of dried tart cherries adds natural sweetness and a fruity twist. With a short preparation time and a relatively low sugar content, this recipe is a great option for you to satisfy your chocolate cravings while staying on track with your dietary goals.
